title: The Longer Beard
summary: A visiting scholar from Baghdad boasted in the mosque: "The dignity of a scholar is proportional to the length and fullness of his beard!" His own beard reached his waist....
full_text:
A visiting scholar from Baghdad boasted in the mosque: "The dignity of a scholar is proportional to the length and fullness of his beard!" His own beard reached his waist.

Nasruddin stood up, stroking his own modest chin: "Sir, if wisdom were measured by the length of hair upon the chin, the village goat would be the supreme grand mufti of the world!"
moral: Measuring wisdom by the length of a beard mistakes outward hair for inner intellect.
